definitions.gloss: government office, government agency, public authority
definitions.explanation: A general term for administrative offices of the national or local government. Often used to refer to government agencies collectively or to the buildings that house them.

examples.japanese: {官庁|かんちょう}{街|がい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The government district is in Kasumigaseki.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧{官庁|かんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{連携|れんけい}→連携：05094_renkei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Various government agencies are working together on countermeasures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{官庁|かんちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦{公務員|こうむいん}→公務員：01588_koumuin⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: Staff of central government agencies must pass the national civil service examination.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term used in news and official contexts. {官庁|かんちょう}{街|がい} (government district) refers specifically to the Kasumigaseki area of Tokyo where most central government ministries are located. The compound ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{官庁|かんちょう} means central government agencies (ministries), while ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{官庁|かんちょう} refers to regional government offices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {官庁|かんちょう}{街|がい}: government office district
- ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{官庁|かんちょう}: central government agency
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧{官庁|かんちょう}: relevant government agencies
- {所管|しょかん}{官庁|かんちょう}: competent authority
